docs.text: It's 78° here today and feels more like July than it does in October. At least Lake Michigan is gracing us with a nice onshore breeze. #906Life #PureMichigan
Water temperatures are almost up to 70 here on the northwest corner of Lake Michigan. And yes, I did enjoy my first swim of the year 😊 #906Life #mymichigan
May 16, 1926: On the hottest day yet this spring (83 degrees), day trippers plunge into Lake Michigan at Chicago’s Winona Avenue Beach.

Another #coldwater swim in the books! Storm coming later this week, so we stayed in and enjoyed 54 degree water temps for 20 minutes or so. Lake Michigan is so large, it takes a long time to cool down after summer ends.
80 degrees all the way to Lake Superior on *checks notes* October 21. 🥵
I see why you are fleeing! May it be beautiful when you visit. 🌸 (I can't afford CA right now, so it's always a visit for me.) It's ~55F right now in my corner of the Great Lakes. 70s later today.
To be fair, there’s swimming in a pool and swimming in Lake Michigan and they’re entirely different things even when the water temp isn’t 33.6
Brrr. I once went swimming in Lake Michigan in July on a particularly windy overcast day and it felt like 40°. I got in up to my neck though! It was refreshing Lol
Lake Michigan water was probably 72-74 degrees today. It was weird swimming there before noon with the sun to my back when facing the lake.
Yes it's going to be 88 degrees here & with climate change the past few years I've taken an October swim in Lake Michigan.😉
Another gorgeous swimming day in Lake Michigan at Grand Haven. Water temp 67 degrees, 10/3/25:
Oh, that's not hot ... 98, feels like 107 ... 😉🤯🔥 Going house hunting along north shore of Lake Ontario the end of the month. Recommend anywhere nice for old retired couple? 😁🤷
